content:
mike: Heads-up — staging cut job failed during build. Several steps died with EMFILE/too many open files from our self-hosted runners. Blocking the cut.

deploy-bot: buildkite: build #423 failed — pipeline canceled by CI due to exit code 1 :warning:

anya: Can we just restart the runner pool and re-run?

jordan: We hit this on canary yesterday. Repro looks like a file-descriptor leak during container cleanup in runner-image:1.8.2. Parallel builds escalate it quickly.

sarah: Pasting the most relevant tail from runner.log and sysctl output:
```
2026-03-20T18:12:01Z ERROR EMFILE: open '/proc/self/fd/10240'
2026-03-20T18:12:01Z WARN leaked fd during container cleanup: fd=10240
2026-03-20T18:12:01Z ERROR container cleanup failed, continuing with partial cleanup
...
# sysctl fs.file-nr
10240 0 16384
```

mike: Thanks. Temporary mitigation proposal: pin runners to runner-image:1.8.0 (pre-leak) and restart pool, then re-trigger the pipeline. I'll add a note to release docs/change window that we pinned the runner image for the cut. :clock1:

anya: +1 to pin for this cut. We need to avoid delaying the customer rollout. Also open an infra ticket for the real fix (INFRA-432).

jordan: Agreed. Alternative short-term: bump ulimit on runners to buy time, but that feels brittle; prefer pin + restart.

mike: I'll patch our terraform to pin the image tag and kick a rolling restart of the autoscaling group. Doing the restart now, ETA ~15m. :hammer_and_wrench:

deploy-bot: action: rerun build #423 as #423.1 with RUNTIME_RUNNER_TAG=1.8.0 (pinned).

sarah: Monitoring fd metrics and runner logs. If we still see EMFILEs I'll fall back to manual rollback plan. :eyes:

jordan: I'll open a short PR with a temporary ulimit increase and link INFRA-432 for follow-up if needed.

mike: Decision: pin for cut and proceed if canary rerun is green. If rerun fails -> hold release and escalate INFRA-432, plus run rollback playbook. I'll update the release notes and change window to reflect the pin and the potential follow-up.

deploy-bot: canary rerun started for #423.1 — monitoring.

sarah: Canary looks healthy so far, no EMFILEs in the last 5 minutes.

mike: Good. Proceeding with cut after full pipeline passes. Will post final status here.

(END)
